semantics.identity: Caller-supplied numeric project/issue identity and canonical web URLs must match the selected native authority, including configured API/web origins and prefixes. Mutations use the numeric project route.
semantics.authentication: One explicitly selected existing-native environment/keyring identity for all reads, mutation and reconciliation. No official profile, account-equivalence assumption, new store or credential export.
semantics.redirects: No redirects or automatic retries, including same-origin cross-path replay; shared productnative owns enforcement.
semantics.type: Create sends issue_type=issue. An explicit null response description is empty content; a missing description is unproven. No additional metadata fields.
semantics.note: Plain non-system non-internal note. Exact direct-response target and content evidence, never latest-note searches.
semantics.state: close/reopen request closed/opened. Expected state is an observation, not atomic compare-and-swap. No GitHub close reason or bundled comment.
semantics.quick_actions: Reject slash-leading description/comment lines before credential resolution, including lines in code fences.
semantics.ambiguity: Unconfirmed mutation outcomes remain ambiguous even if state readback matches. Attempts count intended native transfers, not proof of transmission or provider application.
semantics.limits: Private title <=1024 bytes; body <=131072 bytes; each JSON response <=2097152 bytes; aggregate <=8388608 bytes. Preflight/write/readback 10/20/10 seconds inside the 45-second operation lifetime. Fixed reads, no pagination.
semantics.platform_limit: Windows persisted-native-config/self-managed mapping behavior is unproven; this contract does not expand general Windows authentication support.
